translations.idiomatic: He was not on good terms with chief clerk of the pacified barbarians Liu Xingzu.

sentences.zh: 十一年，奐遣軍主朱公恩征蠻失利，興祖欲以啟聞，奐大怒，收付獄。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Huan sent Army Commander Zhu Gong'en to attack the barbarians and failed; Xingzu wished to memorialize and report; Huan was greatly angry and had him imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Huan sent Army Commander Zhu Gong'en to attack the barbarians and failed. Xingzu wished to memorialize and report. Huan was greatly angry and had him imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 興祖於獄以針畫漆合盤為書，報家稱枉，令啟聞，而奐亦馳信啟上，誣興祖扇動荒蠻。

translations.literal: Xingzu in prison with a needle drew on a lacquer box and tray as writing, reporting to his family that he was wronged, ordering memorial and report; yet Huan also sent urgent memorial reporting that Xingzu incited the wild barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzu in prison with a needle drew on a lacquer box and tray as writing, reporting to his family that he was wronged, ordering memorial and report. Yet Huan also sent urgent memorial reporting that Xingzu incited the wild barbarians.

sentences.zh: 上知其枉，敕送興祖還都，奐恐辭情翻背，輒殺之。

translations.literal: The emperor knew he was wronged; the order sent Xingzu back to the capital; Huan feared the words would turn against him and immediately killed him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor knew he was wronged. The order sent Xingzu back to the capital. Huan feared the words would turn against him and immediately killed him.

sentences.zh: 上大怒，遣中書舍人呂文顯、直合將軍曹道剛領兵收奐，又別詔梁州刺史曹武自江陵步出襄陽。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angry and sent Palace Library Attendant Lu Wenxian and Direct Guard General Cao Daogang leading troops to take Huan; again a separate edict ordered Inspector of Liang Province Cao Wu to march from Jiangling on foot out of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly angry and sent palace library attendant Lu Wenxian and direct guard general Cao Daogang leading troops to take Huan. Again a separate edict ordered inspector of Liang Province Cao Wu to march from Jiangling on foot out of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 奐子彪凶愚，頗幹時政，士人咸切齒。

translations.literal: Huan's son Biao was fierce and stupid and quite interfered in the age's government; scholars all gnashed teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's son Biao was fierce and stupid and quite interfered in the age's government. Scholars all gnashed teeth.

sentences.zh: 時文顯以漆匣匣箜篌在船中，因相誑云，「台使封刀斬王彪」。

translations.literal: At the time Wenxian because a lacquer case holding a konghou was in the boat therefore deceived them, saying, "The terrace messenger's sealed blade will behead Wang Biao."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wenxian because a lacquer case holding a konghou was in the boat therefore deceived them, saying, "The terrace messenger's sealed blade will behead Wang Biao."

sentences.zh: 及道剛、曹武、文顯俱至，眾力既盛，又懼漆匣之言，於是議閉門拒命。

translations.literal: When Daogang, Cao Wu, and Wenxian all arrived, the host's strength was already abundant and again they feared the lacquer case's words; therefore they discussed closing the gate and refusing the order.
translations.idiomatic: When Daogang, Cao Wu, and Wenxian all arrived, the host's strength was already abundant and again they feared the lacquer case's words. Therefore they discussed closing the gate and refusing the order.

sentences.zh: 長史殷叡，奐女婿也，諫曰：「今開城門，白服接台使，不過檻車征還，隳官免爵耳。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk Yin Rui, Huan's son-in-law, admonished, "Now opening the city gate and in plain dress receiving the terrace messenger — at most a caged cart summons back, rank stripped and office removed.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Clerk Yin Rui, Huan's son-in-law, admonished, "Now opening the city gate and in plain dress receiving the terrace messenger — at most a caged cart summons back, rank stripped and office removed.

sentences.zh: 」彪堅執不從，叡又曰：「宜遣典簽間道送啟自申，亦不患不被宥。

translations.literal: Biao firmly held and would not follow; Rui again said, "It is fitting to send the record keeper by a side road delivering memorial self-reporting — again no worry of not being pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Biao firmly held and would not follow. Rui again said, "It is fitting to send the record keeper by a side road delivering memorial self-reporting — again no worry of not being pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」乃令叡書啟，遣典簽陳道齊出城，便為文顯所執。

translations.literal: He therefore had Rui write the memorial and sent Record Keeper Chen Daoqi out of the city; he was immediately seized by Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore had Rui write the memorial and sent Record Keeper Chen Daoqi out of the city. He was immediately seized by Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 叡又曰：「忠不背國，勇不逃死，百世門戶，宜思後計，孰與仰藥自全，則身名俱泰，叡請先驅螻蟻。

translations.literal: Rui again said, "Loyalty does not betray the state, courage does not flee death — a hundred-generation gate household should think of the later plan; who compares to looking up and taking medicine to preserve oneself, then body and name both grand? Rui asks to go first as an ant.
translations.idiomatic: Rui again said, "Loyalty does not betray the state, courage does not flee death — a hundred-generation gate household should think of the later plan. Who compares to looking up and taking medicine to preserve oneself, then body and name both grand? Rui asks to go first as an ant.

sentences.zh: 」又不從。

translations.literal: Again he would not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Again he would not follow.

sentences.zh: 奐門生鄭羽叩頭啟奐，乞出城迎台使，奐曰：「我不作賊，欲先遣啟自申，政恐曹、呂輩小人相陵藉，故且閉門自守耳。

translations.literal: Huan's student Zheng Yu kowtowed and reported to Huan, begging to go out of the city to welcome the terrace messenger; Huan said, "I am not making rebellion — I wish first to send memorial self-reporting; I just fear Cao, Lu, and the like, petty men, will bully and insult — therefore for now close the gate and self-guard.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's student Zheng Yu kowtowed and reported to Huan, begging to go out of the city to welcome the terrace messenger. Huan said, "I am not making rebellion — I wish first to send memorial self-reporting. I just fear Cao, Lu, and the like, petty men, will bully and insult — therefore for now close the gate and self-guard.

sentences.zh: 」彪遂出戰，敗走歸。

translations.literal: Biao then went out to battle, was defeated and fled back.
translations.idiomatic: Biao then went out to battle, was defeated and fled back.

sentences.zh: 土人起義，攻州西門，彪登門拒戰，卻之。

translations.literal: Local men rose in righteousness and attacked the western gate of the province; Biao ascended the gate and resisted battle and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Local men rose in righteousness and attacked the western gate of the province. Biao ascended the gate and resisted battle and repelled them.

sentences.zh: 司馬黃瑤起、甯蠻長史裴叔業于城內起兵攻奐，奐聞兵入，禮佛，未及起，軍人斬之，彪及弟爽、弼、殷叡皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Marshal Huang Yaogi rose and Chief of the Pacified Barbarians Pei Shuye within the city raised troops attacking Huan; Huan heard soldiers enter, worshipped Buddha, and before he could rise soldiers beheaded him; Biao and younger brothers Shuang, Bi, and Yin Rui were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Huang Yaogi rose and Chief of the Pacified Barbarians Pei Shuye within the city raised troops attacking Huan. Huan heard soldiers enter, worshipped Buddha, and before he could rise soldiers beheaded him. Biao and younger brothers Shuang, Bi, and Yin Rui were all executed.

sentences.zh: 奐長子太子中庶子融，融弟司徒從事中郎琛，於都棄市，余孫皆原宥。

translations.literal: Huan's eldest son Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Rong, Rong's younger brother Attendant in the Minister of Education's office Chen — at the capital they were abandoned in market; remaining grandsons were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's eldest son Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Rong, Rong's younger brother Attendant in the Minister of Education's office Chen — at the capital they were abandoned in market. Remaining grandsons were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 琛弟肅、秉並奔魏，後得黃瑤起臠食之。

translations.literal: Chen's younger brothers Su and Bing both fled to Wei; later they obtained Huang Yaogi and ate his flesh.
translations.idiomatic: Chen's younger brother Su and Bing both fled to Wei. Later they obtained Huang Yaogi and ate his flesh.

sentences.zh: 弟伷女為長沙王晃妃，以男女並長，又且出繼，特不離絕。

translations.literal: Younger brother Chou's daughter was consort to Prince of Changsha Huang; because male and female were both grown and moreover she had gone out in succession, specially they did not sever.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Chou's daughter was consort to Prince of Changsha Huang. Because male and female were both grown and moreover she had gone out in succession, specially they did not sever.

sentences.zh: 奐既誅，故舊無敢至者，汝南許明達先為奐參軍，躬為殯斂，經理甚厚，當時高其節。

translations.literal: After Huan was executed, old friends dared not come; Xu Mingda of Runan had first been Huan's staff officer and personally performed the encoffining and management very generously; the age honored his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: After Huan was executed, old friends dared not come. Xu Mingda of Runan had first been Huan's staff officer and personally performed the encoffining and management very generously. The age honored his integrity.

sentences.zh: 奐弟份。

translations.literal: Huan's younger brother Fen.
translations.idiomatic: Huan's younger brother was Fen.

sentences.zh: 份字季文。

translations.literal: Fen, styled Jiwen.
translations.idiomatic: Fen, styled Jiwen.

sentences.zh: 仕宋位始安內史。

translations.literal: Serving Song he reached Internal Administrator of Shian.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Song he reached internal administrator of Shian.

sentences.zh: 袁粲之誅，親故無敢視者，份獨往致慟，由是顯名。

translations.literal: When Yuan Can was executed, relatives and old friends dared not look; Fen alone went and expressed grief and thereby was illustriously named.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Can was executed, relatives and old friends dared not look. Fen alone went and expressed grief and thereby was illustriously named.

sentences.zh: 累遷大司農。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to grand minister of agriculture.

sentences.zh: 奐誅後，其子肅奔魏，份自拘請罪，齊武帝宥之。

translations.literal: After Huan was executed his son Su fled to Wei; Fen himself bound himself and requested guilt; Emperor Wu of Qi pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: After Huan was executed his son Su fled to Wei. Fen himself bound himself and requested guilt. Emperor Wu of Qi pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 肅屢引魏人至邊，份嘗因侍坐，武帝謂曰：「比有北信不？

translations.literal: Su repeatedly led Wei men to the border; Fen once because of attending seated, Emperor Wu said, "Recently has there been northern news?
translations.idiomatic: Su repeatedly led Wei men to the border. Fen once because of attending seated, Emperor Wu said, "Recently has there been northern news?

sentences.zh: 」份改容對曰：「肅既近忘墳柏，寧遠憶有臣。

translations.literal: Fen changed countenance and answered, "Su has near forgotten tomb cypress — how can he far remember having a minister.
translations.idiomatic: Fen changed countenance and answered, "Su has near forgotten tomb cypress — how can he far remember having a minister.

sentences.zh: 」帝亦以此亮焉。

translations.literal: The emperor also because of this was bright toward him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also because of this was bright toward him.

sentences.zh: 後位秘書監。

translations.literal: Later he reached Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Later he reached supervisor of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 仕梁位散騎常侍，領步兵校尉，兼起部尚書。

translations.literal: Serving Liang he reached Regular Attendant, Colonel of Foot Soldiers, and concurrently Director of the Office of Construction.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Liang he reached regular attendant, colonel of foot soldiers, and concurrently director of the office of construction.

sentences.zh: 武帝嘗於宴席問群臣曰：「朕為有為無？

translations.literal: Emperor Wu once at a banquet asked the host, "Am I having action or not?
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu once at a banquet asked the host, "Am I having action or not?

sentences.zh: 」份曰：「陛下應萬物為有，體至理為無。

translations.literal: Fen said, "Your Majesty responds to the myriad things as having action; embodies utmost principle as having no action.
translations.idiomatic: Fen said, "Your Majesty responds to the myriad things as having action. Embodies utmost principle as having no action.

sentences.zh: 」帝稱善。

translations.literal: The emperor praised it as good.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised it as good.

sentences.zh: 後累遷尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Later he was repeatedly promoted to Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was repeatedly promoted to left vice director of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 曆侍中，特進，左光祿大夫，監丹陽尹。

translations.literal: He successively served as Attendant-in-Ordinary, Special Grand Master, Left Grand Master of Splendid Brightness, and Supervisor of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as attendant-in-ordinary, special grand master, left grand master of splendid brightness, and supervisor of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡曰鬍子。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous title Huzi.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Posthumous title Huzi.

sentences.zh: 長子琳，字孝璋，位司徒左長史。

translations.literal: His eldest son Lin, styled Xiaozhang, reached Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Lin, styled Xiaozhang, reached left chief clerk of the minister of education.

sentences.zh: 琳齊代取梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，並知名。

translations.literal: Lin in the Qi succession took Emperor Wu of Liang's younger sister the Princess of Yixing as wife; he had nine sons, all illustriously named.
translations.idiomatic: Lin in the Qi succession took Emperor Wu of Liang's younger sister the Princess of Yixing as wife. He had nine sons, all illustriously named.

sentences.zh: 長子銓，字公衡，美風儀，善占吐，尚武帝女永嘉公主，拜駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: Eldest son Quan, styled Gongheng, had fine bearing and deportment and was skilled at physiognomy from speech; he married Emperor Wu's daughter the Princess of Yongjia and was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law.
translations.idiomatic: Eldest son Quan, styled Gongheng, had fine bearing and deportment and was skilled at physiognomy from speech. He married Emperor Wu's daughter the Princess of Yongjia and was appointed commandant of the imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 銓雖學業不及弟錫，而孝行齊焉，時人以為銓、錫二王，可謂玉昆金友。

translations.literal: Quan though learning did not reach younger brother Xi yet filial conduct was equal; men of the time because of this said the two Wangs Quan and Xi could be called jade elder brother and gold friend.
translations.idiomatic: Quan though learning did not reach younger brother Xi yet filial conduct was equal. Men of the time because of this said the two Wangs Quan and Xi could be called jade elder brother and gold friend.

sentences.zh: 母長公主疾，銓形貌瘠貶，人不復識。

translations.literal: When the Princess Dowager was ill Quan's appearance and body were emaciated and declined; men no longer recognized him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Princess Dowager was ill Quan's appearance and body were emaciated and declined. Men no longer recognized him.

sentences.zh: 及居喪，哭泣無常，因得氣疾。

translations.literal: When in mourning residence he wept without constancy and thereby obtained qi illness.
translations.idiomatic: When in mourning residence he wept without constancy and thereby obtained qi illness.

sentences.zh: 位侍中、丹陽尹。

translations.literal: He reached Attendant-in-Ordinary and Governor of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: He reached attendant-in-ordinary and governor of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 卒于衛尉卿。

translations.literal: He died at Minister of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He died at minister of the guard.

sentences.zh: 子溥，字伯淮，尚簡文帝女余姚公主。

translations.literal: His son Pu, styled Bohuai, married Emperor Jianwen's daughter the Princess of Yuyao.
translations.idiomatic: His son Pu, styled Bohuai, married Emperor Jianwen's daughter the Princess of Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 銓弟錫字公嘏，幼而警悟，與兄弟受業，至應休散，輒獨留不起，精力不倦，致損右目。

translations.literal: Quan's younger brother Xi, styled Gongjia, in youth was alert and comprehending; with brothers receiving instruction, when it came to rest and dismissal he alone always stayed and did not rise; energy and strength unwearied, he damaged the right eye.
translations.idiomatic: Quan's younger brother Xi, styled Gongjia, in youth was alert and comprehending. With brothers receiving instruction, when it came to rest and dismissal he alone always stayed and did not rise. Energy and strength unwearied, he damaged the right eye.

sentences.zh: 十二為國子生，十四舉清茂，除秘書郎，再遷太子洗馬。

translations.literal: At twelve he was a National University student; at fourteen he was recommended as Pure and Eminent and was appointed Secretary Gentleman and again transferred to Heir Apparent's Reader.
translations.idiomatic: At twelve he was a National University student. At fourteen he was recommended as Pure and Eminent and was appointed secretary gentleman and again transferred to heir apparent's reader.

sentences.zh: 時昭明太子尚幼，武帝敕錫與秘書郎張纘使入宮，不限日數。

translations.literal: At the time Crown Prince Zhaoming was still young; Emperor Wu ordered Xi with Secretary Gentleman Zhang Zuan to enter the palace without limit on days.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Crown Prince Zhaoming was still young. Emperor Wu ordered Xi with Secretary Gentleman Zhang Zuan to enter the palace without limit on days.

sentences.zh: 與太子游狎，情兼師友。

translations.literal: With the crown prince he played intimately; feeling combined teacher and friend.
translations.idiomatic: With the crown prince he played intimately. Feeling combined teacher and friend.

sentences.zh: 又敕陸倕、張率、謝舉、王規、王筠、劉孝綽、到洽、張緬為學士，十人盡一時之選。

translations.literal: Again the emperor ordered Lu Yan, Zhang Shuai, Xie Ju, Wang Gui, Wang Jun, Liu Xiaochuo, Dao Qia, and Zhang Mian as scholars — ten men all were selection of the time.
translations.idiomatic: Again the emperor ordered Lu Yan, Zhang Shuai, Xie Ju, Wang Gui, Wang Jun, Liu Xiaochuo, Dao Qia, and Zhang Mian as scholars — ten men all were selection of the time.

sentences.zh: 錫以戚屬，封永安侯。

translations.literal: Xi because of maternal kin was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: Xi because of maternal kin was enfeoffed as marquis of Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 普通初，魏始連和，使劉善明來聘，敕中書舍人朱異接之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putong Wei first joined in peace and sent Liu Shanming as envoy; the order had Palace Library Attendant Zhu Yi receive him.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Putong Wei first joined in peace and sent Liu Shanming as envoy. The order had palace library attendant Zhu Yi receive him.

sentences.zh: 善明彭城舊族，氣調甚高，負其才氣，酒酣謂異曰：「南國辯學如中書者幾人？

translations.literal: Shanming was of Pengcheng old clan; spirit and tone very high; relying on his talent and spirit, when wine was deep he said to Yi, "How many men like the Director of the Palace Library are there in the southern state's debate and learning?
translations.idiomatic: Shanming was of Pengcheng old clan. Spirit and tone very high. Relying on his talent and spirit, when wine was deep he said to Yi, "How many men like the director of the palace library are there in the southern state's debate and learning?

sentences.zh: 」異曰：「異所以得接賓宴，乃分職是司，若以才辯相尚，則不容見使。

translations.literal: Yi said, "The reason Yi can receive guests at banquet is that division of duty is this office; if comparing talent and debate as superior, then one cannot be sent to meet.
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "The reason Yi can receive guests at banquet is that division of duty is this office. If comparing talent and debate as superior, then one cannot be sent to meet.

sentences.zh: 」善明乃曰：「王錫、張纘，北間所聞，云何可見？

translations.literal: Shanming then said, "Wang Xi and Zhang Zuan — heard of in the northern region — how can they be seen?
translations.idiomatic: Shanming then said, "Wang Xi and Zhang Zuan — heard of in the northern region — how can they be seen?

sentences.zh: 」異具啟聞，敕即使南苑設宴，錫與張纘、朱異四人而已。

translations.literal: Yi fully reported and reported; the order immediately had the southern park set a banquet — Xi with Zhang Zuan and Zhu Yi, four men only.
translations.idiomatic: Yi fully reported and reported. The order immediately had the southern park set a banquet — Xi with Zhang Zuan and Zhu Yi, four men only.

sentences.zh: 善明造席，遍論經史，兼以嘲謔。

translations.literal: Shanming came to the mat and broadly discussed classics and history, together with mockery and jest.
translations.idiomatic: Shanming came to the mat and broadly discussed classics and history, together with mockery and jest.

sentences.zh: 錫、纘隨方酬對，無所稽疑，善明甚相歎挹。

translations.literal: Xi and Zuan according to each side answered; nothing was stuck in doubt; Shanming greatly sighed and held in esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Xi and Zuan according to each side answered. Nothing was stuck in doubt. Shanming greatly sighed and held in esteem.

sentences.zh: 他日謂異曰：「一日見二賢，實副所期，不有君子，安能為國。

translations.literal: Another day he said to Yi, "In one day seeing two worthies truly matches what was expected; without a gentleman, how can one be a state.
translations.idiomatic: Another day he said to Yi, "In one day seeing two worthies truly matches what was expected. Without a gentleman, how can one be a state.

sentences.zh: 」引宴之日，敕使左右徐僧權於坐後，言則書之。

translations.literal: On the day of leading the banquet the order had attendants Xu Sengquan behind the seat — if words then write them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of leading the banquet the order had attendants Xu Sengquan behind the seat — if words then write them.

sentences.zh: 累遷吏部郎中，時年二十四。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Masters of Personnel and was then aged twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to director in the masters of personnel and was then aged twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 謂親友曰：「吾以外戚謬被時知，兼比羸病，庶務難擁，安能舍其所好而徇所不能。

translations.literal: He told relatives and friends, "I because of maternal kin wrongly received the age's knowledge and moreover am lately weak and ill; the myriad affairs are hard to embrace — how can I abandon what I love and follow what I cannot.
translations.idiomatic: He told relatives and friends, "I because of maternal kin wrongly received the age's knowledge and moreover am lately weak and ill. The myriad affairs are hard to embrace — how can I abandon what I love and follow what I cannot.

sentences.zh: 」乃稱疾不拜。

translations.literal: He therefore claimed illness and did not receive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore claimed illness and did not receive appointment.

sentences.zh: 便謝遣胥徒，拒絕賓客，掩扉覃思，室宇蕭然。

translations.literal: He then dismissed clerks and attendants, refused guests, closed the door and deeply thought; the chamber was desolate.
translations.idiomatic: He then dismissed clerks and attendants, refused guests, closed the door and deeply thought. The chamber was desolate.

sentences.zh: 諸子溫凊，隔簾趨倚。

translations.literal: The sons warm and cool, separated by curtain hastening to lean.
translations.idiomatic: The sons warm and cool, separated by curtain hastening to lean.

sentences.zh: 公主乃命穿壁，使子涉、湜觀之。

translations.literal: The princess therefore ordered the wall pierced so sons She and Shi could view.
translations.idiomatic: The princess therefore ordered the wall pierced so sons She and Shi could view.

sentences.zh: 卒年三十六，贈侍中，諡貞子。

translations.literal: He died aged thirty-six; posthumously given Attendant-in-Ordinary and posthumous title Zhenzi.
translations.idiomatic: He died aged thirty-six. Posthumously given attendant-in-ordinary and posthumous title Zhenzi.

sentences.zh: 錫弟僉。

translations.literal: Xi's younger brother Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Xi's younger brother was Qian.

sentences.zh: 僉字公會，八歲丁父憂，哀毀過禮。

translations.literal: Qian, styled Gonghui, at eight years encountered mourning for his father; grief and destruction exceeded ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Qian, styled Gonghui, at eight years encountered mourning for his father. Grief and destruction exceeded ritual.

sentences.zh: 初補國子生，祭酒袁昂稱為通理。

translations.literal: At first he supplemented as National University student; Director of the University Yuan Ang called him penetrating in principle.
translations.idiomatic: At first he supplemented as National University student. Director of the University Yuan Ang called him penetrating in principle.

sentences.zh: 累遷始興內史，丁所生母憂，固辭不拜。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Internal Administrator of Shixing; encountering mourning for his biological mother he firmly declined and did not receive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to internal administrator of Shixing. Encountering mourning for his biological mother he firmly declined and did not receive appointment.

sentences.zh: 又除南康內史，在郡義興主薨，詔起復郡。

translations.literal: Again he was appointed Internal Administrator of Nankang; in the commandery the Princess of Yixing died; the order had him rise and return to the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Again he was appointed internal administrator of Nankang. In the commandery the Princess of Yixing died. The order had him rise and return to the commandery.

sentences.zh: 後為太子中庶子，掌東宮管記。

translations.literal: Later he served as Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and held the Eastern Palace record.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as junior mentor of the heir apparent and held the Eastern Palace record.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈侍中。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously given Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Posthumously given attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 元帝下詔：賢而不伐曰恭，追諡曰恭子。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan issued edict: worthy and not boasting is called Gong — posthumously given title Gongzi.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan issued edict: worthy and not boasting is called Gong — posthumously given title Gongzi.

sentences.zh: 僉弟通。

translations.literal: Qian's younger brother Tong.
translations.idiomatic: Qian's younger brother was Tong.

sentences.zh: 勱字公齊，美風儀，博涉書史，恬然清簡，未嘗以利欲幹懷。

translations.literal: Li, styled Gongqi, had fine bearing and deportment, broadly passed through books and history, was tranquil and pure and simple, and never had profit and desire disturb the bosom.
translations.idiomatic: Li, styled Gongqi, had fine bearing and deportment, broadly passed through books and history, was tranquil and pure and simple, and never had profit and desire disturb the bosom.

sentences.zh: 仕梁為輕車河東王功曹史。

translations.literal: Serving Liang he was Merit Officer on the staff of the Prince of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Serving Liang he was merit officer on the staff of the Prince of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 王出鎮京口，勱將隨之蕃。

translations.literal: The prince went out to garrison Jingkou; Li was about to follow him to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The prince went out to garrison Jingkou. Li was about to follow him to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 范陽張纘時典選舉，勱造纘言別，纘嘉其風采，乃曰：「王生才地，豈可遊外府乎？

translations.literal: Zhang Zuan of Fanyang then held selection and promotion; Li visited Zuan to speak farewell; Zuan praised his bearing and deportment and therefore said, "Lord Wang's talent and ground — how can he wander in an outer prefecture?
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zuan of Fanyang then held selection and promotion. Li visited Zuan to speak farewell. Zuan praised his bearing and deportment and therefore said, "Lord Wang's talent and ground — how can he wander in an outer prefecture?

sentences.zh: 」奏為太子洗馬。

translations.literal: He memorialized him as Heir Apparent's Reader.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized him as heir apparent's reader.

sentences.zh: 後為南徐州別駕從事史。

translations.literal: Later he served as Assistant in the Staff Office of South Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as assistant in the staff office of South Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，敕令從輦側。

translations.literal: At the end of Datong Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed Zhufang; Li followed precedent in welcoming; the order had him follow at the carriage side.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Datong Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs. The route passed Zhufang. Li followed precedent in welcoming. The order had him follow at the carriage side.

sentences.zh: 所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。

translations.literal: Mountains and rivers passed — none he did not look back and ask; Li according to each matter answered; all had old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and rivers passed — none he did not look back and ask. Li according to each matter answered. All had old precedent.

sentences.zh: 又從登北顧樓賦詩，辭義清典，帝甚嘉之。

translations.literal: Again following ascending the northern Gu Tower he composed poetry; words and meaning pure and canonical; the emperor greatly praised it.
translations.idiomatic: Again following ascending the northern Gu Tower he composed poetry. Words and meaning pure and canonical. The emperor greatly praised it.

sentences.zh: 時河東王為廣州刺史，乃以勱為冠軍河東王長史、南海太守。

translations.literal: At the time the Prince of Hedong was Inspector of Guangzhou; he therefore made Li Chief Clerk to the Prince of Hedong, Champion, and Administrator of Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Prince of Hedong was inspector of Guangzhou. He therefore made Li chief clerk to the Prince of Hedong, Champion, and administrator of Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 王至嶺南，多所侵掠，因懼罪稱疾，委州還朝，勱行州府事。

translations.literal: The prince reached Lingnan and in many cases encroached and plundered; because he feared guilt he claimed illness, entrusted the province and returned to court; Li held provincial and prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The prince reached Lingnan and in many cases encroached and plundered. Because he feared guilt he claimed illness, entrusted the province and returned to court. Li held provincial and prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 越中饒沃，前後守宰，例多貪縱，勱獨以清白著聞。

translations.literal: Yue was rich and fertile; before and after guarding prefects as a rule were mostly greedy and unrestrained; Li alone with pure whiteness was heard of.
translations.idiomatic: Yue was rich and fertile. Before and after guarding prefects as a rule were mostly greedy and unrestrained. Li alone with pure whiteness was heard of.

sentences.zh: 入為給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: He entered office as Giver of Affairs and Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He entered office as giver of affairs and attendant of the yellow gate.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，奔江陵，歷位晉陵太守。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion he fled to Jiangling and successively reached Administrator of Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion he fled to Jiangling and successively reached administrator of Jinling.

sentences.zh: 時兵饑之後，郡中雕弊，勱為政清簡，吏人便安之。

translations.literal: At the time after soldiers and famine the commandery was wasted and ruined; Li in governance was pure and simple; clerks and people were at ease.
translations.idiomatic: At the time after soldiers and famine the commandery was wasted and ruined. Li in governance was pure and simple. Clerks and people were at ease.

sentences.zh: 徵為侍中，遷五兵尚書。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Attendant-in-Ordinary and transferred to Director of the Five Arms.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as attendant-in-ordinary and transferred to director of the five arms.

sentences.zh: 會魏軍至，元帝征湘州刺史宜豐侯蕭循入援，以勱監湘州。

translations.literal: When Wei army arrived Emperor Yuan summoned Inspector of Xiang Province the Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun to enter as aid and made Li supervise Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei army arrived Emperor Yuan summoned inspector of Xiang Province the Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun to enter as aid and made Li supervise Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 及魏平江陵，敬帝承制，以為中書令，加侍中。

translations.literal: When Wei pacified Jiangling Emperor Jing by provisional order made him Director of the Palace Library and gave Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei pacified Jiangling Emperor Jing by provisional order made him director of the palace library and gave regular attendant.

sentences.zh: 曆陳武帝司空、丞相長史，侍中、中書令並如故。

translations.literal: He successively served Emperor Wu of Chen as Minister of Works, Chief Clerk to the Chancellor, Attendant-in-Ordinary, and Director of the Palace Library all unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served Emperor Wu of Chen as minister of works, chief clerk to the chancellor, attendant-in-ordinary, and director of the palace library all unchanged.

sentences.zh: 及蕭勃平，以勱為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: When Xiao Bo was pacified he was made Inspector of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Bo was pacified he was made inspector of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 未行，改為衡州刺史。

translations.literal: Before going he was changed to Inspector of Heng Province.
translations.idiomatic: Before going he was changed to inspector of Heng Province.

sentences.zh: 王琳據有上流，衡、廣攜貳，勱不得之鎮，留於大庾嶺。

translations.literal: Wang Lin held the upper stream; Heng and Guang were divided in allegiance; Li could not reach his garrison and remained at Dayu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin held the upper stream. Heng and Guang were divided in allegiance. Li could not reach his garrison and remained at Dayu Ridge.

sentences.zh: 質字子貞，少慷慨，涉獵書史。

translations.literal: Zhi, styled Zizhen, in youth was generous and passed through books and history.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi, styled Zizhen, in youth was generous and passed through books and history.

sentences.zh: 梁世以武帝甥，封甲口亭侯。

translations.literal: In the Liang age because he was Emperor Wu's maternal nephew he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiakou Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Liang age because he was Emperor Wu's maternal nephew he was enfeoffed as marquis of Jiakou Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 立太子中舍人、庶子。

translations.literal: He was established Attendant of the Heir Apparent and Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: He was established attendant of the heir apparent and junior mentor.

sentences.zh: 侯景濟江，質領步騎頓于宣陽門外。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing crossed the river Zhi led infantry and cavalry stationed outside Xuanyang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing crossed the river Zhi led infantry and cavalry stationed outside Xuanyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 景軍至都，質不戰而潰，為桑門，潛匿人間。

translations.literal: Jing's army reached the capital; Zhi did not battle and collapsed; he became a monk and secretly hid among men.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's army reached the capital. Zhi did not battle and collapsed. He became a monk and secretly hid among men.

sentences.zh: 城陷後，西奔荊州。

translations.literal: After the city fell he fled west to Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: After the city fell he fled west to Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 元帝承制，歷位侍中，吳州刺史，領鄱陽內史。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan by provisional order successively reached Attendant-in-Ordinary, Inspector of Wu Province, and concurrently Internal Administrator of Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan by provisional order successively reached attendant-in-ordinary, inspector of Wu Province, and concurrently internal administrator of Poyang.

sentences.zh: 魏平荊州，侯瑱鎮盆城，與質不協，質率所部依於留異。

translations.literal: When Wei pacified Jing Province Hou Jin garrisoned Pencheng and was not in harmony with Zhi; Zhi led his division and relied on Liu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei pacified Jing Province Hou Jin garrisoned Pencheng and was not in harmony with Zhi. Zhi led his division and relied on Liu Yi.

sentences.zh: 陳永定二年，武帝命質率所部隨都督周文育討王琳。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongding Emperor Wu ordered Zhi to lead his division following Commander Zhou Wenyu to attack Wang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongding Emperor Wu ordered Zhi to lead his division following Commander Zhou Wenyu to attack Wang Lin.

sentences.zh: 質與琳素善，或譖雲於軍中潛信交通，武帝命文育殺質，文育啟救之，獲免。

translations.literal: Zhi and Lin in origin were on good terms; some slandered saying in the army he secretly sent letters and communicated; Emperor Wu ordered Wenyu to kill Zhi; Wenyu memorialized to save him and he was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi and Lin in origin were on good terms. Some slandered saying in the army he secretly sent letters and communicated. Emperor Wu ordered Wenyu to kill Zhi. Wenyu memorialized to save him and he was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 文帝嗣位，以為五兵尚書。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded he was made Director of the Five Arms.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen succeeded he was made director of the five arms.

sentences.zh: 宣帝輔政，為司徒左長史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuan assisted in governance he was Left Chief Clerk of the Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan assisted in governance he was left chief clerk of the minister of education.

sentences.zh: 坐招聚博徒，免官。

translations.literal: For gathering and enticing gamblers he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: For gathering and enticing gamblers he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 後為都官尚書。

translations.literal: Later he served as Director of the Office of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Later he served as director of the office of punishments.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡曰安子。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous title Anzi.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Posthumous title Anzi.

sentences.zh: 弟固。

translations.literal: Younger brother Gu.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother was Gu.

sentences.zh: 固字子堅，少清正，頗涉文史。

translations.literal: Gu, styled Zijian, in youth was pure and upright and quite passed through literary and historical works.
translations.idiomatic: Gu, styled Zijian, in youth was pure and upright and quite passed through literary and historical works.

sentences.zh: 梁時以武帝甥，封莫口亭侯。

translations.literal: In the Liang age because he was Emperor Wu's maternal nephew he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Mokou Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Liang age because he was Emperor Wu's maternal nephew he was enfeoffed as marquis of Mokou Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 位丹陽尹丞。

translations.literal: He reached Assistant Governor of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: He reached assistant governor of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 梁元帝承制，以為相國戶曹屬，掌管記。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang by provisional order made him Household Clerk of the State of Xiang and held the record.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang by provisional order made him household clerk of the State of Xiang and held the record.

sentences.zh: 尋聘魏，魏人以其梁氏外戚，待之甚厚。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent as envoy to Wei; Wei men because he was Liang clan maternal kin treated him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was sent as envoy to Wei. Wei men because he was Liang clan maternal kin treated him very generously.

sentences.zh: 廢帝即位，授侍中、金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jing ascended he was appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary and Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jing ascended he was appointed attendant-in-ordinary and grand master of splendid brightness with gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 宣帝輔政，固以廢帝外戚，奶媼恒往來禁中，頗宣密旨，事泄，比黨皆誅，宣帝以固本無兵權，且居處清素，止免所居官，禁錮。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuan assisted in governance Gu because he was Emperor Jing's maternal kin — wet nurses constantly went back and forth in the forbidden inner quarters and quite spread secret intent — when affairs leaked the whole faction was executed; Emperor Xuan because Gu in origin had no military power and moreover dwelling was pure and simple only removed the office he held and confined.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan assisted in governance Gu because he was Emperor Jing's maternal kin — wet nurses constantly went back and forth in the forbidden inner quarters and quite spread secret intent — when affairs leaked the whole faction was executed. Emperor Xuan because Gu in origin had no military power and moreover dwelling was pure and simple only removed the office he held and confined.

sentences.zh: 太建中，卒于太常卿，諡恭子。

translations.literal: In the Taichong era he died at Minister of Ceremonies; posthumous title Gongzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taichong era he died at minister of ceremonies. Posthumous title Gongzi.

sentences.zh: 固清虛寡欲，居喪以孝聞。

translations.literal: Gu was pure and empty with few desires and in mourning residence was heard of for filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Gu was pure and empty with few desires and in mourning residence was heard of for filial piety.

sentences.zh: 又信佛法。

translations.literal: Again he believed in Buddhist dharma.
translations.idiomatic: Again he believed in Buddhist dharma.

sentences.zh: 及丁所生母憂，遂終身蔬食，夜則坐禪，晝誦佛經。

translations.literal: When he encountered mourning for his biological mother he therefore all his life ate vegetables; at night then sat in meditation; by day recited Buddhist sutras.
translations.idiomatic: When he encountered mourning for his biological mother he therefore all his life ate vegetables. At night then sat in meditation. By day recited Buddhist sutras.

sentences.zh: 嘗聘魏，因宴饗際，請停殺一羊。

translations.literal: Once sent as envoy to Wei; therefore at the banquet interval he requested stopping the killing of one sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Once sent as envoy to Wei. Therefore at the banquet interval he requested stopping the killing of one sheep.

sentences.zh: 羊於固前跪拜。

translations.literal: The sheep before Gu kowtowed.
translations.idiomatic: The sheep before Gu kowtowed.

sentences.zh: 又宴昆明池，魏人以南人嗜魚，大設罟網，固以佛法祝之，遂一鱗不獲。

translations.literal: Again at Kunming Pool Wei men because southern men love fish greatly set nets; Gu with Buddhist dharma prayed and thereby not one scale was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Again at Kunming Pool Wei men because southern men love fish greatly set nets. Gu with Buddhist dharma prayed and thereby not one scale was obtained.

sentences.zh: 子寬，位侍中。

translations.literal: His son Kuan reached Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: His son Kuan reached attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 論曰：王誕夙有名輩，而間關夷險，卒獲攀光日月，遭遇蓋其時焉。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Wang Dan from youth had a name among peers; through hardship among barbarians and danger he finally obtained climbing to sun and moon — encounter was probably his time.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: Wang Dan from youth had a name among peers. Through hardship among barbarians and danger he finally obtained climbing to sun and moon — encounter was probably his time.

sentences.zh: 奉光、奉叔，並得官成齊代，而亮自著寒松，固為優矣。

translations.literal: Fengguang and Fengshu both obtained office completion in the Qi age; yet Liang by himself showed cold pine — truly he was superior.
translations.idiomatic: Fengguang and Fengshu both obtained office completion in the Qi age. Yet Liang by himself showed cold pine — truly he was superior.

sentences.zh: 瑩印章六毀，豈鬼神之害盈乎？

translations.literal: Ying's seal six times destroyed — was it spirits' harm to fullness?
translations.idiomatic: Ying's seal six times destroyed — was it spirits' harm to fullness?

sentences.zh: 景文弱年立譽，芳聲籍甚，榮貴之來，匪由勢至。

translations.literal: Jingwen in weak years established reputation; fragrant fame was very great; glory and nobility coming was not from power reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Jingwen in weak years established reputation. Fragrant fame was very great. Glory and nobility coming was not from power reaching.

sentences.zh: 若使泰始之朝，身非外戚，與袁粲群公，方驂並路，傾覆之災，庶幾可免。

translations.literal: If in the Taishi court his person were not maternal kin and with Yuan Can and the host of dukes side by side on the road, overturning disaster would probably almost be avoidable.
translations.idiomatic: If in the Taishi court his person were not maternal kin and with Yuan Can and the host of dukes side by side on the road, overturning disaster would probably almost be avoidable.

sentences.zh: 庾元規之讓中書令，義歸此矣。

translations.literal: Yu Yuankui's declining Director of the Palace Library — righteousness returns to this.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yuankui's declining director of the palace library — righteousness returns to this.

sentences.zh: 奐有愚子，自致誅夷。

translations.literal: Huan had a foolish son and by himself brought execution and extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Huan had a foolish son and by himself brought execution and extinction.

sentences.zh: 份胤嗣克昌，特鍾門慶，美矣。

translations.literal: Fen's descendants succeeded in flourishing increase; specially the gate's celebration was beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: Fen's descendants succeeded in flourishing increase. Specially the gate's celebration was beautiful.
